# pangolin_resource_policy_password (Resource)

Sets the password of a Pangolin resource policy (Enterprise). Every resource attached to the policy asks for it. Destroying this resource removes the password.

> **Note:** The password value cannot be read back from the Pangolin API. After import, you must set the `password` attribute manually to avoid drift detection issues.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_resource_policy_password" "example" {
  resource_policy_id = pangolin_resource_policy.example.id
  password           = var.policy_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password, 4 to 100 characters.
- `resource_policy_id` (Number) The ID of the resource policy to protect with a password.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pangolin_resource_policy_password.example <resource_policy_id>
```
